verdict.rationale: Modal documents its own spend-limit control: a Workspace budget to cap monthly spend. It also states that a timeout length is configurable, and that resources scale to zero so idle time isn't billed. The evidence is single-line mentions, so whether the budget hard-stops running workloads and how the timeout bounds a runaway container are not shown. missing for 10: documented budget enforcement behavior (hard stop vs. alert), detail on the auto-shutdown/timeout mechanism and its limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can set auto-shutdown timers or spend limits so a forgotten instance can't silently run up a huge bill

citations.quote: If you want to limit your monthly spend, you can [set a Workspace budget](/docs/guide/budgets#workspace-budgets).
However, this timeout length is configurable.
You never pay for idle resources — just actual compute time, by the CPU cycle.
